memories.title: Origin: unified-entity-state showed need for cross-repo pattern detection
memories.content: During 2026-03-28 session, Kirk observed that the unified-entity-state problem (3 bugs sharing a root cause) would have been caught earlier by a team role that reads accumulated knowledge and cross-references it against planned work. Kirk framed this as the platform engineer role — seeing what's hindering devs and how it could be improved.

memories.title: Chose Platform Engineer approach over Pattern Detector or Codebase Evolver
memories.content: Evaluated three approaches: (A) narrow pattern detector, (B) platform engineer with friction forecasting, (C) wide autonomous codebase evolver. Chose B — wide enough to catch structural friction before it bites, focused enough that findings are relevant to the current session. C was too noisy, A missed friction forecasting.

memories.title: Simplifier reports first in team startup, before PM
memories.content: Chose to make the simplifier the first voice in team startup rather than standalone pre-session or PM-feeding. This way Kirk hears the structural picture before the operational picture, and can factor it into task assignment.
